from omegaconf import OmegaConf
from pocket_coffea.parameters import get_default_parameters

# Step 1: Fetch the framework's default parameter set
defaults = OmegaConf.create(get_default_parameters())

# Step 2: Load and overlay the two YAML files onto defaults
object_preselection = OmegaConf.load("params/object_preselection.yaml")
triggers = OmegaConf.load("params/triggers.yaml")

# Merge: files override defaults (later configs take precedence)
parameters = OmegaConf.merge(defaults, object_preselection, triggers)

# Final OmegaConf parameters object
print(parameters)
